run_visualize_annotations: run the script to visualize ground-truth annotations from a Detectron2 dataset config file
run_visualize_dataloader: run the script to visualize preprocessed images from a Detectron2 training data loader
run_visualize_with_display: run the script with --show flag to display annotated images in an OpenCV window
run_visualize_with_output_dir: run the script to save annotated images to a specified output directory
run_visualize_keypoint_filter: run the script to visualize dataset images filtered by minimum keypoint count
